PLAYTORRIO — ONE OWNER-AUTHORIZED iOS-ONLY ADDON TELEMETRY BUILD — 17 NOVEMBER 2026 SGT

Owner request: Improve telemetry for newly installed iPhone addons whose catalog rows load but selecting a show fails. Trigger a GitHub iOS build, then leave without monitoring.

WHAT CHANGED
Shared privacy-safe, opt-in diagnostics now trace catalog load/empty/error, detail navigation and metadata failures, addon stream status and parse/network errors, Watch source discovery and cached-only hidden sources.
Private TorriODB iOS reports now include only a broad phone/tablet/unknown display class, not a device identifier.
No raw addon URLs, content titles, stream URLs, media IDs, tokens, exception text or personalized account details.
New regression checks test allowlisted diagnostics and report privacy in the iOS native workflow.
Preserve current Windows, iOS, player, TorBox, subtitles and application identity.

[ios-only]
SINGLE BUILD AUTHORIZATION
This marker update requests exactly ONE signed iOS 15 native IPA through .github/workflows/ios-speech-release.yml on parity-floating-player-both.
Do not start Windows, paired, PS4, workflow_dispatch or duplicate build jobs.
This source change instruments failures; it does not claim that the user's addon already works.

STOP BOUNDARY
Once this commit is accepted, the owner authorization is consumed. Do not poll Actions, inspect workflow completion, GitHub Releases, Telegram, assets, SHA256, telemetry or device state; do not retry or trigger a duplicate without a new owner request.
